UserRequest.description:
User Request

The request parameters for creating or updating a user.

name.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user. Must be unique.

password.description: The password (min 8 characters). Required on create, optional on update.

avatar.description: URL or path to the user avatar image.

UserRequest.title: UserRequest

id.description: The unique identifier of the user (ULID).

name.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

avatar.description: The URL or path to the user's avatar image.

roles.description: The list of roles assigned to the user.

permissions.description: The list of all permissions granted to the user (aggregated from roles and direct permissions).

email_verified_at.description: The date time when the user's email was verified.

created_at.description: The date time when the user was created.

updated_at.description: The date time when the user was updated.

deleted_at.description: The date time when the user was deleted.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
